To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of a video recording of an everyday situation as a basis for a prospective memory task can produce results that are consistent with those obtained using a more traditional laboratory task.
a video based procedure is an effective way of assessing prospective memory in the laboratory and has the potential to become a useful clinical measure.
the video based prospective memory test is a valid and reliable measure of prospective memory that is easier to complete when set in a familiar rather than unfamiliar setting.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and validation of a new measure of prospective memory.
a specific form of memory known as prospective memory.
the assessment and treatment of memory problems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the video based procedure has a high ecological validity, is reliable and has criterion validity.

this study has provided evidence that video based prospective memory tests can be constructed with high ecological validity, and that the video method is reliable, easy to complete, and can be used to assess prospective memory in persons with brain injury.

prospective memory is a complex and multi-facetted ability that is influenced by a number of variables including the nature of the prospective task, the cue and the environment in which the task is performed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a reliable and valid method of assessing prospective memory that can be applied to clinical or experimental situations.
the use of videos in the assessment of prospective remembering can enhance ecological validity.
the video based procedure for assessing prospective memory is a reliable, valid, and ecologically valid measure of prospective memory.
The main takeaway from our work is that
video-based measures of prospective memory can be developed that have good psychometric credentials.

the video based procedure can be used to assess the everyday functioning of persons with brain injuries, and that the results of such assessments can be used to predict performance in real life situations.
we need to develop more ecologically valid tests of prospective memory and that video based tests can be useful in this regard.
